g.title: Making complex data easier to read

AgriGence brings together weather forecasts, soil insights, and detailed reports. I wanted the typography to make that information feel approachable and easy to scan. Clear headings, readable labels, and prominent figures help users move from the bigger picture to the details that matter.
Rooted in agriculture, designed for clarity

I chose green to connect AgriGence to agriculture and growth, using it to highlight primary actions and active states. White and soft grey give dense dashboards breathing room, while dark text keeps information readable. Supporting colors distinguish weather metrics, chart data, and status messages, helping users recognise important changes at a glance.
